Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test` (architecture, catalog, localization, cache and weather)
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` when interaction or rendering changes
- [ ] Both RU/EN and keyboard/focus behavior checked
Include screenshots for visual changes and note any remaining limitations.
